comments.content: The condition `ctxLength <= 0` is always false for an unsigned integer, so the warning branch is dead code. Since `Uint` already returns the default 2048 when the env var is empty or unparseable, the only way to get 0 is an explicit "0", which this check does catch, but the `<= 0` is misleading. Consider changing to `ctxLength == 0` and updating the warning message to say "context length is 0" rather than "less than 0".
